artworks.title: Description of the Building
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite on wove tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural capital intertwined with foliage and the letter 'D'. The image depicts a detailed architectural element, specifically a capital adorned with carvings and decorative details, accompanied by the letter 'D'. The letter is entwined with flowing organic leaves, adding a natural element to the structured form. The drawing is executed in fine lines on a piece of paper taped to a larger sheet, with handwritten annotations above referring to its catalog details. The style suggests a classical architectural influence combined with graphic design elements.

artworks.title: Study for "Casts from Antique Sculpture: The Parthenon"
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a sculpture depicting a reclining male figure. The sculpture appears to be made of a solid material like stone or plaster, suggested through shading techniques in the sketch, which is predominantly executed in shades of grey pencil on paper. The figure is partially draped and muscular, with a relaxed posture. Behind the figure are additional sketches, including a dynamic scene of two figures on horseback and a smaller sketch of a standing figure to the left, also in a classical style. The word "CASTS" is written across the center of the paper.

artworks.title: Study for "Bronzes"
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: There is a sketch of a reclining lion at the top left, along with decorative vases and a plate in the background. The color palette is primarily grayscale, with pencil shading on a cream-colored background. Handwritten text reading "BRONZES Cloisonné Electrotypes etc." is at the center of the image. Below the text, there are lined spaces, indicating an area for writing.

artworks.title: Hammer and Compass
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed black and white illustration with a cluster of tendrils or ribbons intertwined with an object resembling a pair of compasses in a rectangular box or frame. The illustration is monochrome with shades of black and gray on a light background. It is slightly above the center of the paper and surrounded by white space. Faint pencil marks and notations are visible near the edges and corners of the page.

artworks.title: Bison-Dance of the Mandan Indians
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching, aquatint, and mezzotint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1960)

artworks.title: Fujisawa-shuku
artworks.medium: color woodcut on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This print displays a natural scene with people engaged in various activities. At the top, two large mountains peak through misty white clouds against a pale blue-and-white sky. At the bottom is a wide gray path surrounded by green grass, with tall trees sprouting up. A group of people walk on the path, appearing to carry large items. The people are depicted in simple lines, and they have peach skin and are wearing light blue garments. Some have wide yellow hats on. In the distance, behind the trees, the path extends towards a cluster of yellow-and-orange houses at the base of the mountains. On the right side of the print are three rectangles containing vertical characters.

artworks.title: The Charge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene with soldiers and fallen figures. The image depicts a tumultuous and intense war scene. In the foreground and mid-ground, several figures can be seen, some lying on the ground, while others appear to be engaging with each other or aiding a downed figure. The soldiers are equipped with rifles and bayonets. The background features a chaotic sky, with what seems to be smoke or explosions. The drawing uses a monochrome palette with strong contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Seaside Finch; and Grafs Finch or Bay-Winged Bunting
artworks.artist: Julius Bien after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: chromolithograph with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Richard A. Herman, 1984)
artworks.description: There are two birds perched on the left side among green leaves and pink flowers, including roses. On the right side, a bird is standing next to green cacti with yellow blossoms. The color palette includes brown, green, yellow, and pink.

artworks.title: Willows
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge crossing a waterway surrounded by trees. Silhouetted figures are present on the bridge and in the background. The artwork features cross-hatched lines creating texture. The color scheme is black and white. Lush foliage partially hides the bridge, creating a secluded atmosphere. In the distance, figures stand on the bridge. The background features foliage fading into a misty ambiance.

artworks.title: The Little Canyon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a view through a narrow canyon with towering rock formations on either side. The horizon is low in the image, with distant plateaus visible. The piece uses intricate cross-hatching for texture in the rock surfaces and sky, with a monochromatic color palette of black, gray, and off-white. Swirling clouds in the sky are also cross-hatched, adding texture and movement. The rocky terrain leads the eye towards the horizon, framed by cliffs.

artworks.title: A Boy
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a boy standing with his hands behind his back and facing forward. He has a wide smile, round face, dark tousled hair, and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt, knee-length pants with a patched knee, and no shoes. The background is textured, and on the left side, "A BOY" is written vertically. The artist's signature, J. Wells Champney, is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Mermaid
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)

artworks.title: Borwick Hall, Lancashire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: The image shows a historic building from a slightly elevated perspective. The architecture is detailed, with stone walls, chimneys, and various roofs. People are active in the yard in front of the building. The scene is depicted with precise brushstrokes capturing textures and a color palette of earthy tones with greens, reds, and blues.

artworks.title: On the Shepang River, Connecticut
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a serene body of water with a horizon featuring distant trees and hills. In the foreground, there are dense foliage, a path, and the reflection of the sky on the water. The trees are detailed with delicate lines creating a textured surface. The sky has soft clouds, contrasting with the landscape below. The monochrome color palette enhances the interplay of light and shadow, adding to the serene yet dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mrs. J. Coleman Drayton (Charlotte Augusta Astor)
artworks.artist: Stephen James Ferris, after Daniel Huntington
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing the viewer. Her body is turned slightly to the right while her head is turned towards the viewer. She has curly hair framing her forehead, pulled back in an elegant style. She wears an off-the-shoulder dress with floral elements, accessorized with pearls. The woman's arms are resting on a surface, one hand holding a bouquet of flowers. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Mrs. Phillip Nicklin (Julianna Chew)
artworks.artist: Stephen James Ferris, after Gilbert Stuart
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a seated woman facing slightly to her right. She has curly hair and is wearing a dress with short sleeves and a lace choker. Her hands are clasped in front of her, resting on an armrest. In the background, there is a draped curtain with a tassel.

artworks.title: Adobe House
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The scene is captured from a low viewpoint, showing a rustic setting with mountains in the background. A hut with a textured roof and ladder is prominently featured in the center right. Sparse foliage leads to the mountains. Fine brushstrokes and sepia tones create a vintage feel. A figure stands in the middle of the landscape.

artworks.title: Aguirre House (Santa Barbara)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a rustic building to the right, surrounded by grass. In the background, mountains rise with sharp peaks, and there are tall trees. The sky is lightly clouded with a muted color palette of earthy tones and light greys, creating a tranquil ambiance.

artworks.title: Mission San Antonio de Padua
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large building at the center, possibly a mission or historical structure. In the background, mountains are visible. The etching technique used creates detailed lines for the architecture and tree on the left. The color scheme is mainly sepia tones. In the foreground, there is open ground with patches of grass leading to a fenced area and a tree. The building's design includes arches and a cross on the roof. The sky has smooth shading.

artworks.title: Peasant's House
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a thatched roof cottage, a pig, two children, chickens, a cart, trees, and distant buildings. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with the horizon above center. The sky has subtle clouds and flying birds. The artwork features intricate line work to depict textures and a monochromatic color scheme for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Whirlwind
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a massive, twisted tree dominating the left side of the composition. The horizon is obscured by the tree, reaching skyward. In the distance, a landscape of rolling hills and trees can be seen under a tumultuous sky filled with swirling clouds. The style features intricate detailing with fine etching lines, creating texture and depth. The color palette includes black, white, and various shades of gray. The image is titled "The Whirlwind."

artworks.title: Harvesting, New England
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Mrs. J.L.M. Curry, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a row of trees in the middle ground. The scene includes figures engaged in what seems to be agricultural activity. The drawing uses pencil strokes with a soft style, and the paper is a neutral tan color.

artworks.title: Mr. William W. Corcoran
artworks.artist: Goupil & Company, after Charles Loring Elliott
artworks.medium: photogravure in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing next to a chair. He is facing slightly left, with a formal posture. He has a round face with prominent features, light and short hair. The man is dressed in dark-colored formal attire, consisting of a long coat, a vest, and trousers. He is holding a cane in his left hand, with his right hand near his coat. A keychain or watch chain is visible near his left waist. The background is plain with a gradient of light to dark tones, and two high-backed chairs are partially visible.

artworks.title: Mission San Luis Obispo
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a single-story building with columns and a tiled roof, extending from the left to the center. A cross sits on top of a small entrance in the center of the building. Two figures are near the columns, and a horse is to the right. The horizon blends into the sky, with hills or low mountains in the distance. The artwork uses cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows. The color palette is sepia-toned. In the distance, trees and smaller structures are visible, including a palm tree. The scene suggests a location with a mild climate. The composition is balanced, with significant sky space, featuring lightly sketched clouds above the mountains.
